requiredPages.title: Project Profile
requiredPages.purpose: Identify the project, developer, location, scale, and evidence date.

requiredPages.title: Project Scope & Products
requiredPages.purpose: Explain what is being developed and the products, units, or planned scope.

requiredPages.title: Development & Delivery
requiredPages.purpose: Explain development history, delivery status, infrastructure, and material project features.

requiredPages.title: Price & Market Intelligence
requiredPages.purpose: Present dated prices, comparable evidence, calculations, and limitations.

requiredPages.title: Location & Verification
requiredPages.purpose: Show location evidence, access context, source register, and buyer verification checks.

rules: Keep the five page slots and their order identical across projects.
Use the same typography, color tokens, page dimensions, footer placement, and evidence-label treatment.
Keep project facts and sources specific to each project; never copy Bwiza facts into another report.
Use Not established, Not published, or Availability unverified when evidence is missing.
Label asking prices, launch prices, transaction prices, estimates, and historical prices distinctly.
Every material claim must have a traceable source and an as-of date where relevant.
Do not invent unit availability, delivery dates, distances, approvals, or financial terms.
